text: The map_height and map_width attributes of BaseGeometryWidget are deprecated, use CSS to size map widgets instead.
suggestion_reason: GIS map-widget sizing moves from attributes to CSS display rules.

text: The django.contrib.gis.gdal.GDALRaster class now supports pathlib.Path.
suggestion_reason: Code constructing GDALRaster can now pass pathlib.Path.

text: Django 4.2 supports Python 3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11, and 3.12 (as of 4.2.8). We highly recommend and only officially support the latest release of each series.
suggestion_reason: The Python runtime version must be checked against supported versions.

text: The makemigrations --check option no longer creates missing migration files.
suggestion_reason: The migration check command no longer writes missing migration files.

text: Upstream support for MariaDB 10.3 ends in May 2023. Django 4.2 supports MariaDB 10.4 and higher.
suggestion_reason: The deployed MariaDB version must be at least 10.4.

text: Upstream support for PostgreSQL 11 ends in November 2023. Django 4.2 supports PostgreSQL 12 and higher.
suggestion_reason: The deployed PostgreSQL version must be at least 12.

text: F() expressions that output BooleanField can now be negated using ~F() (inversion operator).
suggestion_reason: Negated F expressions change ORM Boolean query behavior.

text: SimpleTestCase.assertFormsetError() is deprecated in favor of assertFormSetError().
suggestion_reason: Tests should call assertFormSetError rather than the deprecated method name.

text: The minimum supported version of asgiref is increased from 3.5.2 to 3.6.0.
suggestion_reason: The installed asgiref version must satisfy the new minimum.

text: The OpenLayers template widget no longer includes inline CSS (which also removes the former map_css block) to better comply with a strict Content Security Policy.
suggestion_reason: The OpenLayers widget no longer renders inline CSS or its map_css block.

text: django.contrib.postgres.fields.CITextField is deprecated in favor of TextField(db_collation="…") with a case-insensitive non-deterministic collation.
suggestion_reason: CITextField replacement involves database collation and field schema.

text: The minimum supported version of redis-py is increased from 3.0.0 to 3.4.0.
suggestion_reason: The installed redis-py version must satisfy the new minimum.

text: The STATICFILES_STORAGE setting is deprecated in favor of STORAGES["staticfiles"].
suggestion_reason: Project static-file settings should move to STORAGES.

text: The undocumented negated parameter of the django.db.models.Exists expression is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code constructing Exists cannot pass the removed negated parameter.

text: The django.contrib.gis.admin.GeoModelAdmin and OSMGeoAdmin classes are removed.
suggestion_reason: Admin integration code cannot import the removed GIS admin classes.

text: The default iteration count for the PBKDF2 password hasher is increased from 600,000 to 720,000.
suggestion_reason: The default password-hasher work factor changes runtime security and cost.

text: request is added to the signature of ModelAdmin.lookup_allowed. Support for ModelAdmin subclasses that do not accept this argument is deprecated.
suggestion_reason: ModelAdmin.lookup_allowed subclasses should accept request.

text: The minimum supported version of docutils is increased to 0.19.
suggestion_reason: The installed docutils version must satisfy the new minimum.

text: The new django.shortcuts.aget_object_or_404 and django.shortcuts.aget_list_or_404 asynchronous shortcuts allow asynchronous getting objects.
suggestion_reason: Async application code can use the new object lookup shortcuts.

text: Django 5.0 supports Python 3.10, 3.11, and 3.12. We highly recommend and only officially support the latest release of each series.
suggestion_reason: The deployed Python runtime must match the supported series.

text: Passing nulls_first=False or nulls_last=False to Expression.asc() and Expression.desc() methods, and the OrderBy expression is no longer allowed.
suggestion_reason: Code passing nulls_first=False or nulls_last=False must change.

text: FORMS_URLFIELD_ASSUME_HTTPS transitional setting is deprecated.
suggestion_reason: The transitional HTTPS form URL setting is deprecated.

text: Passing positional arguments name and violation_error_message to django.db.models.BaseConstraint is deprecated in favor of keyword-only arguments.
suggestion_reason: BaseConstraint calls should use keyword arguments.

text: Integer fields are now validated as 64-bit integers on SQLite to match the behavior of sqlite3.
suggestion_reason: SQLite integer-field validation now enforces 64-bit bounds.

text: On MariaDB 10.7+, UUIDField is now created as UUID column rather than CHAR(32) column. See the migration guide above for more details on migrating-uuidfield.
suggestion_reason: MariaDB UUIDField now uses a native UUID column, requiring schema review.

text: The minimum supported version of selenium is increased from 3.8.0 to 4.8.0.
suggestion_reason: The installed Selenium version must satisfy the new minimum.

text: The undocumented BaseForm._html_output() method is removed.
suggestion_reason: Custom form code cannot call removed BaseForm._html_output.

text: The CSRF_COOKIE_MASKED transitional setting is removed.
suggestion_reason: Project CSRF configuration cannot use the removed setting.

text: Filtering querysets against overflowing integer values now always returns an empty queryset. As a consequence, you may need to use ExpressionWrapper() to explicitly wrap arithmetic against integer fields in such cases.
suggestion_reason: Overflowing integer filters now return empty querysets.

text: The undocumented django.utils.baseconv module is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code importing the removed baseconv module must change.

text: The minimum supported version of asgiref is increased from 3.6.0 to 3.7.0.
suggestion_reason: The installed asgiref version must satisfy the new minimum.

text: The new OGRGeometry.set_3d method allows addition and removal of the Z coordinate dimension.
suggestion_reason: GIS code can call OGRGeometry.set_3d.

text: The minimum supported version of asgiref is increased from 3.7.0 to 3.8.1.
suggestion_reason: The installed asgiref version must satisfy the new minimum.

text: Django 5.1 supports Python 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 (as of 5.1.3). We highly recommend and only officially support the latest release of each series.
suggestion_reason: The deployed Python runtime must match the supported series.

text: The django.contrib.gis.geoip2.GeoIP2.open() method is deprecated. Use the django.contrib.gis.geoip2.GeoIP2 constructor instead.
suggestion_reason: Code calling GeoIP2.open should use the constructor.

text: The DEFAULT_FILE_STORAGE and STATICFILES_STORAGE settings is removed.
suggestion_reason: Storage configuration cannot use the removed settings.

text: Template engines now implement a check() method that is already registered with the check framework.
suggestion_reason: Custom template engines can implement the check method.

text: Upstream support for MariaDB 10.4 ends in June 2024. Django 5.1 supports MariaDB 10.5 and higher.
suggestion_reason: The deployed MariaDB version must be at least 10.5.

text: django.contrib.gis.db.models.functions.BoundingCircle is now supported on SpatiaLite 5.1+.
suggestion_reason: BoundingCircle adds a SpatiaLite database-query capability.

text: django.contrib.gis.gdal.OGRGeometry, django.contrib.gis.gdal.Point, django.contrib.gis.gdal.LineString, django.contrib.gis.gdal.Polygon, and django.contrib.gis.gdal.GeometryCollection and its subclasses now support measured geometries via the new OGRGeometry.is_measured and m properties, and the OGRGeometry.set_measured method.
suggestion_reason: GIS code can access measured-geometry properties and methods.

text: The django.core.files.storage.get_storage_class() function is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code calling the removed get_storage_class function must change.

text: The minimum supported version of asgiref is increased from 3.8.1 to 3.9.1.
suggestion_reason: The installed asgiref version must satisfy the new minimum.

text: The django.contrib.gis.geoip2.GeoIP2.coords() method is removed.
suggestion_reason: GIS code cannot call removed GeoIP2.coords.

text: The default iteration count for the PBKDF2 password hasher is increased from 1,000,000 to 1,200,000.
suggestion_reason: The default password-hasher work factor changes runtime security and cost.

text: The Django 5.2.x series is the last to support Python 3.10 and 3.11.
suggestion_reason: The deployed Python runtime must account for the support cutoff.

text: The DatabaseOperations.fetch_returned_insert_columns() method is removed and the fetch_returned_rows() method replacing fetch_returned_insert_rows() expects both a cursor and returning_params to be provided, just like fetch_returned_insert_columns() did.
suggestion_reason: Custom database backend code must use the new method and arguments.

text: The DjangoDivFormRenderer and Jinja2DivFormRenderer transitional form renderers are removed.
suggestion_reason: Form renderer configuration cannot reference removed renderer classes.

text: Support for calling format_html() without passing args or kwargs is removed.
suggestion_reason: format_html callers must provide args or kwargs.

text: The ForeignObject.get_reverse_joining_columns() method is removed.
suggestion_reason: Custom ForeignObject code cannot call the removed method.

text: The setter for django.contrib.gis.gdal.OGRGeometry.coord_dim is removed.
suggestion_reason: GIS code should call set_3d instead of setting coord_dim.
